Note records how a harness and model did on a task, as agent roster note
does, written by your dream's agent. --session must name a session your
dream was given (its digest lists them): a note rests on evidence the
dream reviewed. --by can't be given.

Usage:
  agent dream roster note HARNESS/MODEL[@EFFORT] "what happened" [flags]

Examples:
  agent dream roster note claude/claude-haiku-5-5 --task edit --verdict good --session claude:3f3a9c "renamed across 12 files cleanly"

Flags:
      --by string        Who wrote it (default: your agent name, or "user")
  -h, --help             help for note
      --session string   The session it came from, as HARNESS:ID (agent sessions lists them)
      --supersedes int   The id of an earlier note on this entry that this one replaces
      --task string      Task kind: edit, bugfix, feature, long-horizon, review, research, design, test, kernel, chat
      --verdict string   Verdict: good, mixed, or bad
      --why string       Why it went that way

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
